XFD Weekly Finale Boss: Round 001 — Horror, Anime, Wrestling, and Gaming Collide

update // Jun 9, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Choose your character.

Four stories, one final boss. That's the new XFD format: every week, each "Boss" represents one major fandom story, and I crown the one that hit hardest.

Round 001:

  • Horror Boss: Scary Movie hit #1.
  • Anime Boss: Anime Expo news dropped.
  • Wrestling Boss: MJF retained.
  • Gaming Boss: State of Play dropped major reveals.

Horror Boss: Scary Movie is back on top

The new Scary Movie, the sixth in the series, opened at #1 with about $54.3 million. That's the biggest opening the franchise has ever had and a record for a parody movie, on a reported budget of about $30 million. Parody is back.

Anime Boss: Anime Expo news

Anime Expo is the biggest anime convention in North America, and the announcements started rolling in ahead of the show in Los Angeles in early July. It's the week every studio and publisher lines up its reveals, and fans had plenty to talk about.

Wrestling Boss: MJF retained

On the June 3 episode of AEW Dynamite, MJF kept the AEW World Championship against RUSH in a bloody, no-countout brawl that ended when RUSH passed out in MJF's crossface. That was barely a week after MJF won the title back from Darby Allin at Double or Nothing in a Title vs. Hair match.

Gaming Boss: State of Play (my pick)

Sony's June 2 State of Play was stacked:

  • God of War: Laufey, which puts you in control of Faye, Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother.
  • New gameplay from Marvel's Wolverine.
  • Until Dawn 2, from Firesprite.
  • Release dates for Control Resonant, Onimusha: Way of the Sword and Silent Hill: Downfall.
  • Dune: Awakening coming to PS5.

My XFD pick: the Gaming Boss took the crown. A brand-new God of War starring Faye, plus real Wolverine gameplay, in one show? That's a final boss.

Update (September 2026)

A few follow-ups:

  • Anime Expo delivered for Sonic fans: Sega revealed Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond, the animated short starring Metal Sonic. I covered it in The Season of Metal.
  • Less than a month after this State of Play, Sony announced it's ending physical discs for new PlayStation games in 2028. My take is here.
  • Pokémon Toxic Traits Part 2 dropped the next day, like I promised: Your favorite Pokémon exposes your red flags.

Sources: Deadline on Scary Movie, PlayStation Blog, POST Wrestling, All Elite Wrestling

Quick answers

What is the XFD Weekly Finale Boss? A weekly XFD format where each "Boss" is one major fandom story from horror, anime, wrestling and gaming, and one gets crowned the winner.

How much did Scary Movie (2026) make opening weekend? About $54.3 million, #1 at the box office and a record for the franchise.

What was announced at the June 2026 State of Play? God of War: Laufey, new Marvel's Wolverine gameplay, Until Dawn 2 and release dates for several games.

Did MJF retain against RUSH? Yes, on the June 3, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite.
